g.text: ANTERIOR VIEW OF THE HEART. DEOXYGENATED BLOOD ENTERS THE RIGHT ATRIUM, PASSES THE

text.font-family: 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif

g.text: TRICUSPID VALVE TO THE RIGHT VENTRICLE AND LEAVES BY THE PULMONARY ARTERY; OXYGENATED BLOOD RETURNS TO

text.font-family: 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif

g.text: THE LEFT ATRIUM, CROSSES THE MITRAL VALVE TO THE LEFT VENTRICLE AND LEAVES BY THE AORTA
